text: Manon's new puppy arrives on Saturday. A cocker spaniel, apparently, and the kids have already named him Biscuit.
Kaito's daughter starts reception on 4th September. He sounded more nervous about it than she is.
Remind me to text Laura on Friday to ask how her mum's hip operation went.
Yosef said his cat Pepper has been off her food for a week. Vet appointment is tomorrow morning. I should check in with him after.
Efua graduates from Leeds on 18 July. Her parents are flying over from Accra for it.
Andre and his wife are celebrating ten years married next Thursday. He wants to book somewhere nice but hasn't decided where.
Caught up with Anjali at the school gate. Her son Ravi has his 11+ exam on 14/09 and he's really anxious about it. Must send her a message the night before to wish him luck.
Catalina's brother Tomás is moving to Lisbon in a fortnight for a new job.
Lukas mentioned his dog Rolo turns five this weekend. They're doing a little party in the garden with a dog-friendly cake, which is very Lukas.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning before Wednesday and book the boiler service.
Ibrahim is a vegetarian and can't stand mushrooms. Worth remembering for the dinner.
Bogdan's driving test was cancelled because of the snow. He's rebooked it for 3rd of December.
Chantal said her dad has been in and out of hospital since August. She's finding it hard to juggle work and visiting. I need to call her this weekend.
Damian got into Edinburgh to study medicine! Results came through yesterday. Don't forget to send him a card.
Jorge works as a sound engineer at the Roundhouse. Loves vinyl, especially old Brazilian jazz.
Björn's son Oliver has his first football match on Sunday. Björn is coaching the team as well, so he's slightly stressed.
Lindiwe told me her sister Nora is expecting twins in March. Lindiwe is going to be an auntie for the first time and is over the moon.
Hassan's kitten, Mochi, had to have an operation on her leg on Monday. She's recovering well but has to wear the cone for ten days. Remind me to ask Hassan how she's getting on next week.
Afua's mum turns seventy on 22 November. Afua is organising a surprise lunch and asked if I could help with the decorations.
I'm taking the train to Bristol on Friday and back on Sunday evening.
Ignacio and Chiara are getting married on 6th June next year! Venue is a farmhouse in Tuscany.
Ines has her piano grade 5 exam on Tuesday. She's been practising every evening and says she feels ready.
Caitlin's daughter lost her first tooth today and was apparently very proud of the tooth fairy money.
Yuki starts her new job at the design agency on Monday 2nd. She mentioned she's a bit nervous about the commute.
Kasia and her partner Marek are moving into their first house on the 30th. Should get them a housewarming plant.
Joanna's son Kemal graduates on Thursday. She said he'd love a decent fountain pen for work, if I'm stuck for a present.
Aurelio, or Ari as everyone calls him, finally passed his PhD viva last week. Need to message him to congratulate him properly.
Manon told me Biscuit has already chewed through two chargers and a shoe. She's exhausted but loving it.
Laura said her mum is home now and doing much better. Physio twice a week for the next month.
Follow up with Kaito: how did his daughter's first week at school go?
Andre's mum is having cataract surgery on 12 March. He's taking the day off to drive her there.
Efua mentioned her brother Kwame failed his driving theory test again. He's retaking it on 9th of May and is pretty fed up.
Lukas is allergic to nuts. Also gluten-free since last year.
Catalina said Tomás's leaving do is this Saturday at the Lamb. I'm going, so don't book anything else.
Anjali mentioned Ravi passed the 11+! The letter arrived on Friday. I should send a little congratulations card to him.

Long call with Chantal tonight. Her dad was finally discharged on Tuesday, but he needs someone with him most days, so she's going part time from 1 December to look after him. She sounded tired but relieved to have a plan. Her brother Damian is coming down from Glasgow for Christmas to give her a break. Must remember to drop round with some food next week.
Yosef said Pepper's blood tests came back fine, so it was just a stomach bug. Big relief.
Bogdan's partner Lindiwe has a big work presentation on Wednesday. Bogdan says she's been up late rehearsing every night.
Ignacio is a huge Arsenal fan and goes to every home game with his dad.
Jorge's daughter, Afua, is in the school nativity on 16/12. She's playing a sheep and is thrilled.
Need to renew my passport before the end of November.
Hassan and his wife are off to Japan for three weeks from 5 April. Their neighbour is looking after the cat.
Ines's cat Luna died over the weekend. She'd had her for fifteen years. Should text her tomorrow just to see how she's doing.
Kasia's little boy starts nursery next Tuesday. She's dreading the drop-off more than he is.
Björn said Oliver's team won 3-1 on Sunday and Oliver scored. Björn was beaming.
Caitlin mentioned her husband Sean has been made redundant. They found out on Monday. She's putting a brave face on it. I should invite them over for dinner soon.
Damian's graduation ball is on 28 June. His mum has already bought him a suit.
Afua's surprise lunch for her mum has been called off; her mum found out. They're doing a family dinner at home on the 22nd instead.
Joanna told me Kemal's starting at an architecture firm in London in September. He wants to live near Hackney.
Chiara's dog Bruno has been limping since Thursday. She's taking him to the vet on Monday.
Laura works nights at the children's hospital, so never call her before midday.
Weekend plans: Saturday is the car MOT at nine, then the farmers' market. Sunday I'm cooking lunch for the neighbours.
Yuki said her first week at the agency went well. Her manager, Mrs Santos, sounds lovely.
Remind me to ring Uncle Kemal on 3 January for his birthday. He'll be eighty-two.

Andre's son has his GCSE results on 21 August. He's quietly confident about maths but worried about French. Andre says if he gets the grades they'll take him to Barcelona as a treat. Text Andre on results day.
Catalina mentioned Tomás has settled into Lisbon and loves the new job. His girlfriend Ines is joining him there in January.
Nora's twins arrived early on Tuesday! Two girls, both healthy. Lindiwe sent photos. Need to organise a card and a gift from all of us before Friday.
Ibrahim's wife Efua is training for the Manchester half marathon on 19 April. It's her first one and she's worried about her knee.
Kaito's parrot, Kiwi, turned twenty this week. Apparently they live to sixty, so Kaito has made provisions in his will.

Bumped into Manon and her partner Lukas at the park with Biscuit. They're hosting a joint birthday party for their twins on Saturday 14th, in the afternoon. Manon asked if I'd bring a pudding, and Lukas mentioned the twins are obsessed with dinosaurs at the moment, so a dinosaur book would go down well. Also, Manon's mum is visiting from Lyon next week and staying until the 25th. Must order the book by Wednesday.
